title: "Figure 1C-D"
output: html_notebook

Download libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

Download RData from the folder.
```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Load RData file containing data required for analysis and visualization.
load("multiple_cohorts_data.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)

```


Correlation plot.
```{r}
# Specify MHCI pathway genes
MHCI_genes <- c("B2M","ERAP1","ERAP2","HLA.A","HLA.B","HLA.C","NLRC5","PDIA3",
                "PSMB10","PSMB8","PSMB9","PSME1","TAP1","TAP2","TAPBP","TAPBPL",
                "CASP7","GSDMD",
                "CALR","GAPDH")

# Specify IRF genes
IRF_genes <- c("IRF2")
```


Plot correlation heatmap.
```{r}
# Perform correlation analysis.
# given ct = gene in the list,
# the function calculate spearman correlation between IRF2 and ct.
# outputs include rho and p-value.
cor_by_dataset <- map_dfr(datasets, function(ds) {
  sub_df <- filter(df_pre, StudyID == ds)
  map_dfr(MHCI_genes, function(ct) {
    if (sum(!is.na(sub_df[[ct]])) < 5) return(NULL)
    test <- cor.test(sub_df[["IRF2"]], sub_df[[ct]],
                     method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      Dataset  = ds,
      Gene = ct,
      rho      = round(test$estimate, 3),
      p_value  = signif(test$p.value, 3),
      n        = nrow(sub_df),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
}) %>%
  arrange(Dataset, p_value)

# Replace NA rho and NA p-value with 0 and 1, respectively.
cor_by_dataset <- cor_by_dataset %>%
  mutate(across(rho, ~ replace_na(., 0)),
         across(p_value, ~ replace_na(., 1)))

# Extract rho value from the correlation table
# This table will be used for heatmap
mat_cor <- cor_by_dataset %>% 
  subset(Dataset %in% datasets) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset,Gene,rho) %>%
  pivot_wider(.,
               names_from = "Gene",
               values_from = "rho") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(., var = "Dataset") %>%
  dplyr::select(MHCI_genes)

# Rename cohort names
rownames(mat_cor) <- c("Cohort 1", "Cohort 2","Cohort NSCLC")
  
# Extract p-value from the correlation table
# This table will be used for heatmap
mat_pval <- cor_by_dataset %>%
  subset(Dataset %in% datasets) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset,Gene,p_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(.,
               names_from = "Gene",
               values_from = "p_value") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(., var = "Dataset") %>%
  dplyr::select(MHCI_genes)

# Rename cohort names
rownames(mat_pval) <- c("Cohort 1", "Cohort 2", "Cohort NSCLC")

# 2. Define a color palette (e.g., 100 color steps)
my_color <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red"))

# Make row order
custom_rows <- c("Cohort 1", "Cohort 2", "Cohort NSCLC")
# custom_rows <- c("1_PRCR","1_SDPD","2_PRCR","2_SDPD","3_PRCR","3_SDPD")
# custom_rows <- c("IPI-NAIVE","PEM/NIVO-NAIVE","IPI-PROG","IL2/IPI-PROG")
# custom_rows <- c("IPI-NAIVE_PRCR","IPI-NAIVE_SDPD","IPI-PROG_PRCR","IPI-PROG_SDPD")
# custom_rows <- c("PEM/NIVO-NAIVE_PRCR","IPI-NAIVE_PRCR",
#                  "PEM/NIVO-NAIVE_SDPD","IPI-NAIVE_SDPD",
#                  "IPI-PROG_PRCR","IL2/IPI-PROG_PRCR",
#                  "IPI-PROG_SDPD","IL2/IPI-PROG_SDPD")

library(ComplexHeatmap)
Fig1_Corplot_IRF2MHCGenes <- Heatmap(mat_cor,
                           cluster_rows = FALSE,
                           cluster_columns = FALSE,
                           col = my_color,
                           column_names_side = "top",
                           row_names_side = "left",
                           rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
                           name = "Spearman\nCorrelation",
                           # Custom row order
                           row_order = custom_rows,
                           # Custom cell rendering function
                           cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                             
                             if (mat_pval[i, j] > 0.05) {
                               
                               # NON-SIGNIFICANT: White background with a colored 'X'
                               # 1. Draw a white background with a faint border so the grid stays intact
                               grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black"))
                               
                               # 2. Draw the 'X' using the correlation color (the 'fill' variable)
                               # We increase lwd (line width) to 2.5 so the color is easily visible
                               grid.segments(x - width * 0.35, y - height * 0.35, 
                                             x + width * 0.35, y + height * 0.35, 
                                             gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2.5)) # replace col = fill with col = "black"
                               grid.segments(x - width * 0.35, y + height * 0.35,
                                             x + width * 0.35, y - height * 0.35,
                                             gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2.5)) # replace col = fill with col = "black"
                               
                             } else {
                               
                               # SIGNIFICANT: Normal full-sized colored box
                               # The cell is completely filled with the correlation color
                               grid.rect(x, y, width, height, 
                                         gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = "black", lwd = 1))
                               
                             }
                           }
)
                       
Fig1_Corplot_IRF2MHCGenes
```

Draw scatter plot showing correlation between IRF2 and selected gene.
IRF2 vs. HLA-B in Cohort 1 (GSE91061_PHS000452).
```{r}
df_in <- df_pre %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(IRF2,HLA.B) %>%
  `colnames<-`(., c("X","Y")) %>%
  mutate(X = log2(X+1),
         Y = log2(Y+1))

# Draw correlation plot
Fig_CorScatter_HLA.B_C1 <- ggscatter(df_in,
          x = "X",
          y = "Y",
          color = "black",
          size = 0.5,
          add = "reg.line",
          add.params = list(color = "blue",fill = "lightgray"),
          conf.int = TRUE,
          cor.coef = TRUE,
          cor.coeff.args = list(method = "spearman",label.sep = "\n")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "HLA-B",
      y = "IRF2")

Fig_CorScatter_HLA.B_C1
```

Fig1 combine correlation scatter plots (v2).
```{r}
# Create top row, ERAP cohort 1,2,3
Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_top <- ggarrange(Fig_CorScatter_ERAP1_C1,
                                       Fig_CorScatter_ERAP1_C2,
                                       Fig_CorScatter_ERAP1_NSCLC,
                                       nrow = 1, ncol = 3) 

Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_top <- annotate_figure(Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_top,
                                             left = text_grob("", face = "plain", size = 12))


# Create bottom row, GAPDH cohort 1,2,3
Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_bottom <- ggarrange(Fig_CorScatter_GAPDH_C1,
                                          Fig_CorScatter_GAPDH_C2,
                                          Fig_CorScatter_GAPDH_NSCLC,
                                          nrow = 1, ncol = 3) 

Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_bottom <- annotate_figure(Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_bottom,
                                              left = text_grob("", face = "plain", size = 12))



Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2v2 <- ggarrange(Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2_top, 
                                   Fig1B_CorScatter_IRF2_bottom,
                                   nrow = 2, ncol = 1, align = "hv")

Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2v2
```

Fig1 combined Fig1A and Fig1B(v2).
```{r}
# capture the rendered heatmap as a grob
ht_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(Fig1_Corplot_IRF2MHCGenes))

# convert grob -> ggplot object
ht_gg <- as_ggplot(ht_grob)

library(patchwork)
# Make a white spacer and put it between the two plots
my_white_spacer <- ggplot() + theme_void() #plot_spacer() + theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))

Fig1v2_pre <- ggarrange(ht_gg, my_white_spacer, Fig1_CorScatter_IRF2v2,
                   nrow = 3, ncol = 1, align = "v",heights = c(1,0.25,3), labels = c("A","","B"))

Fig1v2_pre
```
